title: Helm Chart Templating: Package Kubernetes Manifests
title_es: Templating con Helm: empaquetar manifiestos Kubernetes
description: Complete runnable Helm chart: Chart.yaml with OCI dependencies, values.yaml plus per-environment overrides, templates for Deployment, Service, ConfigMap and Ingress, named helpers, a post-install hook Job, a SealedSecret example, .helmignore and NOTES.txt.
description_es: Helm chart completo y ejecutable: Chart.yaml con dependencias OCI, values.yaml más overrides por entorno, templates para Deployment, Service, ConfigMap e Ingress, helpers nombrados, un Job de hook post-install, un ejemplo de SealedSecret, .helmignore y NOTES.txt.
